import { LosslessNumber, readJsonStrict, writeJsonLossless, } from '@omne-harness-lite/content-blocks';
/** Consume the released strict JSON boundary, with no caller-data mutation. */
export function jsonValue(value) {
    let text;
    try {
        text = writeJsonLossless(value);
    }
    catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof TypeError)
            return undefined;
        throw error;
    }
    const result = readJsonStrict(text);
    if ('failed' in result)
        throw new Error('lossless writer produced invalid JSON');
    return result.ok;
}
export function isObject(value) {
    return (value !== null &&
        typeof value === 'object' &&
        !Array.isArray(value) &&
        !LosslessNumber.is(value));
}
export function isStringArray(value) {
    return Array.isArray(value) && value.every(item => typeof item === 'string');
}
